title: 第164章 别驾归顺第163章 高调开府
slug: 绑定全国每人每天给我一两银
lines: 王家府邸。
王纮正恭立在父亲身前，汇报今日云王开府之事。
“纮儿，你当家多久了？”躺椅上，王兴舟耷拉着眼皮，声音飘出，听不出情绪。
活了一百多岁的他早已不管外事，今日却破例叫来了自己的嫡子。
“回父亲，三十年了。”王纮恭敬道。
“三十年了……”王兴舟念叨着，苍老脸上浮现出追忆之色：“不知不觉竟然这么久了。”
他双手撑着躺椅，想要起身。
王纮连忙去扶。
王兴舟却抬手拦住了他，强撑着坐起，浑浊的双眸看向自己这嫡子：“既如此，那你回诛越县休息一段时间吧。”
诛越县是王家发家之地，是他们势力基本盘所在。
王纮脸色微变，忍不住道：“父亲，您觉得王家也会如上官家那般？”
他自然清楚父亲不是在夺权，而是希望他避一避风头。
王兴舟端起旁边热茶，抿了一口，感慨道：“为父没想到，这云王竟有如此能力。”
“此番开府，哪怕是田世安都无法限制他了。”
“我们王家乃商贾之家，却仗着扎根多年，垄断了城中粮食，早已犯了忌讳。”
“所以不管这次是谁赢，我们都该退场了。”
商不与士斗！
在权力面前，所谓的钱财、关系，都不值一提。
若是以往他们还能借着在官场中的人脉去维系，但显然，不论是田世安还是云王，都不可能再让他们王家这般放肆。
王纮双手微微攥紧，深沉的脸上满是不甘，他咬牙道：“父亲，我们还有机会的。”
“如今田世安与云王势同水火，我们未尝不能乱中取胜。”
王兴舟微微摇头：“痴儿，你真以为我们斗得过他们？”
他活得够久，看得也更透，沉声道：“现在退出，我王家的产业或许会没，但人脉关系还在。”
“最重要的是，钱财资本还在，还能在诛越县靠着护越都府继续存活。”
“你要记住，我们四大豪强之所以能存活数百年，靠的可不是简单的垄断而已。”
王兴舟看向自己的嫡子，神情认真：“铁打的胥吏，流水的官。只要王家基业还在，这个家就不会散！”
王纮的拳头微微松开。
他知道，父亲说得没错。
只是自己操持王家这么多年，亲手将王家送到最鼎盛的时期，如何愿意就此放下。
王兴舟见儿子还执迷不悟，叹息一声，道：“走吧，这里有为父撑着呢。”
“若事情能好转，我王家还能卷土重来！”
王纮抬头，平日沉稳的脸上再次震惊，不由道：“父亲，您要留下来？”
“王家总归是要留人的，田世安和云王也不会轻易放我们离开。”
王兴舟摆手，淡淡开口：“为父老了，不想动了，正好替你盯着城中产业。”
王纮心生触动，张了张嘴，却不知道该说什么。

The royal residence.
Wang Hongzheng stood respectfully in front of his father, reporting on the opening of King Yun's mansion today.
"Hong'er, how long have you been in charge?" On the recliner, Wang Xingzhou drooped his eyelids, his voice drifted out, and his emotions could not be heard.
Having lived for more than a hundred years, he had long ignored foreign affairs, but today he made an exception and called his legitimate son.
"Return to father, it's been thirty years." Wang Hong said respectfully.
"Thirty years..." Wang Xingzhou muttered, a look of reminiscence appeared on his old face: "Unknowingly, it has been so long."
He held the recliner with both hands and tried to get up.
Wang Hong quickly went to help him.
But Wang Xingzhou raised his hand to stop him, forced himself to sit up, and looked at his legitimate son with cloudy eyes: "In that case, you should go back to Zhuyue County to rest for a while."
Zhuyue County is where the Wang family made their fortune and where their power base lies.
Wang Hong's face changed slightly and he couldn't help but said: "Father, do you think the Wang family will be like the Shangguan family?"
He naturally knew that his father was not trying to seize power, but wanted him to avoid the limelight.
Wang Xingzhou picked up the hot tea next to him, took a sip, and said with emotion: "My father never thought that this King Yun would be so capable."
"With this opening of the mansion, even Tian Shi'an can't restrict him."
"Our Wang family is a family of merchants, but we have monopolized the food in the city by relying on our roots for many years. This has already been a taboo."
"So no matter who wins this time, it's time for us to bow out."
Businessmen do not fight with soldiers!
In the face of power, so-called money and relationships are not worth mentioning.
In the past, they could still rely on their connections in the officialdom to maintain relationships, but obviously, neither Tian Shian nor King Yun would allow the Wang family to be so presumptuous again.
Wang Hong clenched his hands slightly, his deep face full of unwillingness. He gritted his teeth and said, "Father, we still have a chance."
"Now that Tian Shi'an and King Yun are in the same situation, we might not be able to win in chaos."
Wang Xingzhou shook his head slightly: "Chi'er, do you really think we can defeat them?"
He had lived long enough and had seen things more clearly, and said solemnly: "If I withdraw now, my Wang family's property may be gone, but my personal connections will still be there."
"The most important thing is that the money and capital are still there, and we can continue to survive in Zhuyue County by protecting the Yue Capital."
"You have to remember that the reason why our four powerful powers have been able to survive for hundreds of years is not just a simple monopoly."
Wang Xingzhou looked at his legitimate son with a serious expression: "A tough subordinate and a smooth official. As long as the Wang family's foundation remains, this family will never break up!"
Wang Hong's fist loosened slightly.
He knew that his father was right.
It's just that I have managed the Wang family for so many years and personally brought the Wang family to its most prosperous period. How can I be willing to let it go?
Seeing that his son was still stubborn, Wang Xingzhou sighed and said, "Let's go, my father is here to support me."
"If things can get better, our Wang family can make a comeback!"
Wang Hong looked up, his usually calm face was shocked again, and couldn't help but said: "Father, do you want to stay?"
"The Wang family always wants to retain people, and Tian Shi'an and King Yun will not let us go easily."
Wang Xingzhou waved his hand and said calmly: "I'm old and don't want to move anymore. I just keep an eye on the property in the city for you."
Wang Hong was touched and opened his mouth, but he didn't know what to say.
title_en: Chapter 164: Farewell and surrender Chapter 163: Opening the mansion with high profile
